capabilities: Decompose long-term projects into hierarchical node documents with enforced parent-child types
Track task states (planning, in progress, done, shelved, blocked) with parent-child propagation rules
Attach reusable evidence nodes (objects, conditions, information, snapshots) to tasks
Save subtree structures as templates and apply them to new projects
Schedule parallel event timelines and push next actions via flow scripts
extras: README is in Chinese. The plugin is mid-refactor: only transaction design, template mode, and route mode are confirmed fully working; flow features are in testing, other views are still being migrated, and the README may be outdated until a tutorial wiki is written. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ (desktop and mobile). Contact offered via QQ and WeChat.
motivation: The author built it first to satisfy their own personal needs and plans long-term maintenance.
problem: Personal task managers handle long-running, parallel projects poorly: no real project hierarchy, task data locked in visual tools, information separated from tasks, and full todo lists that force constant decisions about what to do next.
summary: Node-based project management plugin that breaks long-term tasks into hierarchical note documents with states, evidence links, templates, and scripted flow pushes.
